extension_points: Packages/features register named rules and optional repair-plan builders.
Issue UI consumes stable location/evidence and service operations.
state_failure_version_rules: This is an L1 draft design contract: no compiled public consumer, BP execution, L2 integration or capability completion is asserted by this file.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Missing-load fixture produces one Issue located on the analysis; repair+recheck clears that rule issue.
Old issues cannot remain current after relevant input changes.
Repair never writes the model directly; stale issue repair plans conflict or recompute explicitly.
Rule/Issue evidence schemas and tolerance versions persist; unsupported rule versions are unavailable.
